result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clearly broken element: the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section is showing a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo. There are also a few minor truncation/clipping issues on the right edge of horizontally scrolling content.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, showing a gray broken-image placeholder icon instead of a photo.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or asset loading for this restaurant, and provide a branded fallback image (e.g., logo or cuisine illustration) instead of a generic broken-image icon when loading fails.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is clipped at the right screen edge without an ellipsis, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal carousel, but consider adding a subtle edge fade or ensuring text truncates with an ellipsis within the card rather than being hard-clipped by the viewport.

issues.description: An extra category filter chip after 'Healthy' is cut off at the right edge and appears as an empty sliver, giving an unfinished look.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding/peek spacing to the chip carousel so partially visible chips show enough of their label to signal scrollability.

issues.description: The '€0 delivery' badge and heart button on the Tokumaru card sit on a plain gray placeholder background, which combined with the broken image makes the whole card look unstyled.
issues.suggestion: When the image is missing, apply a neutral branded background color or skeleton shimmer so overlaid controls still look intentional.
